scope: Atomic exact-clipped GPU copy chunks, replacing ineffective whole-visible-source widening; candidate built, host-validated and directly installed, current server not restarted.

implementation.clipping: Removed 0008 widening. Keep original damage intersected with clipList; no bounding-box overwrite across popup/IME holes.
implementation.queue: Reserve enough of the existing 8 slots for all 16-rectangle chunks before taking references or changing payload. Write all entries, then release-publish writeIndex once.
implementation.completion: All chunks share one monotonically allocated Present serial and one set of ownership references. Existing renderer fence covers the entire group; failure of any chunk marks that same serial failed.
implementation.memory_order: Producer acquires consumer read watermark; renderer releases each slot after reading its entry.
implementation.shared_abi: No field or constant changes; lorie.h identical after removing comments and whitespace.
implementation.limits: At most 8 chunks / 128 rectangles per Present, subject to free slots. Larger regions, queue pressure and unsupported-buffer cases retain safe CPU fallback. Actual failing region was 25 rectangles (2 chunks).

validation.shared_abi: lorie.h identical after removing comments and whitespace; original entry and shared state layout preserved
validation.native_build: Fresh locked source and all arm64 objects; all top-level/nested patches applied with --fuzz=0.
validation.host_test_scope: Production enqueue/is-done/failed/ack C functions and actual shared queue types compiled with host buffer stubs and UBSan. Cases: 1/16/17/25/32/127/128 rectangles, exact sparse clips, root and redirected ownership, unsigned index wrap, insufficient capacity with no partial publication/references, first-chunk failure observable via final serial.
validation.negative_control: The same host test fails on the prior 16-rectangle implementation at the first 17-rectangle case.
validation.physical_window_acceptance: Not yet run with the new server; pending saved-work restart. Host pixel masks do not establish physical screen correctness.

next_step: Saved-work X server restart pending user coordination. Do not run zink scripts or stop the desktop automatically. Confirm new server mapping, then measure the same untraced 640x480 workload; separately sample fallback/pixman and physical pixels/occlusion. Goal remains unproven.
